summary: Six US C-17A Globemaster III cargo planes are deploying from Texas to the Middle East with significant air defense equipment. Iran exhibits heightened air defense activity across multiple provinces including missile launches, anti-aircraft fire, and drone engagements. Israel shares intelligence alleging Iranian chemical weapons plans while Shin Bet arrests a Palestinian rocket-manufacturing cell in Jenin.
key_points: Six US C-17A Globemaster III cargo planes departed Texas for the Middle East carrying significant air defense equipment. (Source: @yediotnews25/137236)
Israel passed intelligence to US and Gulf states claiming Iran plans chemical weapons use; US officials reportedly skeptical, viewing it as Netanyahu pressure campaign. (Source: @yediotnews25/137238)

Iranian air defenses active across Kurdistan, Khuzestan, Hormozgan provinces: AA fire in Sanandaj and Ahvaz, missile launch from Bandar Kangan, IRGC shoots down drone near Minab. (Source: @shin_persian/11966, @shin_persian/11965, @shin_persian/11973, @shin_persian/11972)
Doshan Tappeh Air Base in Tehran damaged during Operation Epic Fury; Iran builds earth mounds on runway of closed airfield to prevent hostile seizure. (Source: @shin_persian/11961)
Shin Bet and Israeli police arrest six Palestinians from Jenin for manufacturing rockets and explosives, conducting at least three launch tests with external guidance. (Source: @manniefabian/59468)

Israeli aircraft drop sound bombs near olive farmers in Halta/Kfar Shuba, drone enters and explodes in Majdal Salm home, launcher bombs fired at Srobbin in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/51639, @redlinkleb/51625, @redlinkleb/51624)
IRGC trucks concealed in Pouneh tunnel on Khorramabad-Borujerd road in Lorestan Province; UKMTO issues maritime warning 195-26. (Source: @shin_persian/11963, @shin_persian/11970)
Threat banner against Trump displayed in Tehran's Revolution Square amid escalating rhetoric. (Source: @yediotnews25/137234)

sections.executive_summary: Six US C-17A Globemaster III cargo planes are deploying from Texas to the Middle East with significant air defense equipment, signaling major force posture changes. Iran shows heightened integrated air defense activity across multiple provinces including missile launches, anti-aircraft fire, and drone interceptions. Israel shares intelligence alleging Iranian chemical weapons preparations while simultaneously disrupting a Palestinian rocket-manufacturing cell in Jenin that conducted multiple launch tests.

points: Doshan Tappeh Air Base in central Tehran, operated by IRIAF, sustained damage during Operation Epic Fury; though closed to flight operations for years, Iran constructed earth mounds along the runway post-operation, likely to prevent hostile forces from landing and seizing the airfield. (Source: @shin_persian/11961)
Anti-aircraft activity reported in Sanandaj, Kurdistan Province, indicating active air defense posture in western Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/11966)
Anti-aircraft firing observed from Kut Abdullah area in Ahvaz, Khuzestan Province, suggesting protection of strategic oil infrastructure. (Source: @shin_persian/11965)
Missile launch detected from Bandar Kangan in Hormozgan Province at 01:36 local time (2206Z), demonstrating operational readiness of southern coastal missile units. (Source: @shin_persian/11973)
IRGC forces engaged and shot down a drone on the outskirts of Minab in Hormozgan Province, confirming active air defense engagements in the Strait of Hormuz region. (Source: @shin_persian/11972)
IRGC trucks concealed in Pouneh tunnel on the Khorramabad-Borujerd road in Lorestan Province, indicating dispersal and concealment measures for mobile assets. (Source: @shin_persian/11963)

Israel shared intelligence with US and Gulf states alleging Iran plans chemical weapons use against adversaries; US officials received the information with concern and skepticism, viewing it as part of a Netanyahu-led pressure campaign. (Source: @yediotnews25/137238)

Six US Air Force C-17A Globemaster III cargo planes departed a Texas base en route to the Middle East carrying significant air defense equipment, marking a substantial US military deployment to the region. (Source: @yediotnews25/137236)

sections.threat_assessment: Iran is demonstrating a heightened, multi-axis air defense posture with simultaneous anti-aircraft engagements in Kurdistan and Khuzestan, a missile launch from Hormozgan, and a drone shoot-down near the Strait of Hormuz. The concealment of IRGC assets in Lorestan tunnels and runway denial measures at Doshan Tappeh suggest preparation for potential aerial conflict. Israel's chemical weapons intelligence sharing — met with US and Gulf skepticism — appears designed to shape Western threat perceptions while Shin Bet disrupts an advancing indigenous rocket capability in Jenin. Lebanese border incidents indicate continued Israeli kinetic pressure below conventional escalation thresholds.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states have received Israeli intelligence on alleged Iranian chemical weapons plans but express credibility doubts, reflecting reluctance to endorse escalatory narratives. The US deployment of six C-17s with air defense assets signals tangible commitment despite official skepticism toward Israeli intelligence claims. UKMTO maritime warning 195-26 indicates recognized shipping threats in Gulf waters. Lebanese border communities absorb repeated Israeli aerial harassment without apparent state-level retaliation. Iraqi Kurdistan saw a false UAV alarm quickly corrected, highlighting information space volatility.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Jenin cell's use of messaging apps for external technical guidance on explosives manufacturing reveals persistent transnational knowledge transfer to West Bank actors. Iran's earth-mound runway denial at a long-closed airfield suggests strategic concern about airfield seizure scenarios beyond current operational needs. The correction on Sulaymaniyah UAV reporting underscores reliance on proxy-affiliated sources with verification gaps. Israeli sound bomb use against olive farmers represents a non-lethal pressure tactic distinct from lethal drone strikes on residential structures. IRGC tunnel concealment in Lorestan aligns with established dispersal doctrine for mobile missile and logistics assets.
